description: Assemblyman DiPietro Addresses the NYS Correctional Officers StrikeAs violence and chaos escalate in New York’s correctional facilities, AssemblymanDavid DiPietro (R,C-East Aurora) is urging every town, city and village in the state to passresolutions in support of correctional officers and demand the repeal of the HALT Act.“Our correctional officers have been abandoned by Albany’s progressive agenda wherecriminals take priority,” said DiPietro. “These men and women put their lives on the line e
title: DiPietro Calls on Local Governments to Stand with Correctional Officers
